<documents>
<document id="overdraft-no-fees">
Doˆyouˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfees?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆchargeˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆorˆnon-sufficientˆfundsˆfeesˆ($0.00)ˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆinsteadˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆhaveˆenoughˆmoney,ˆtheˆtransactionˆisˆsimplyˆdeclined.ˆThere'sˆnoˆchargeˆforˆaˆdecline.ˆ##ˆCushionˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆturnˆonˆCushion,ˆwhichˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆwhenˆyourˆbalanceˆrunsˆshort,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆCushionˆcoversˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ$200ˆonˆPremium.ˆItˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCanˆmyˆbalanceˆstillˆgoˆnegative?ˆRarely.ˆItˆcanˆhappenˆwhenˆaˆmerchantˆchargesˆmoreˆthanˆitˆfirstˆauthorized,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆtipˆaddedˆtoˆaˆrestaurantˆbill,ˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆpaymentsˆIfˆaˆscheduledˆtransferˆorˆanˆACHˆdebitˆcan'tˆbeˆpaid,ˆit'sˆreturnedˆunpaid,ˆwithˆnoˆfeeˆfromˆus.ˆTheˆcompanyˆyouˆoweˆmayˆchargeˆitsˆownˆlateˆfee.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-basic">
CushionˆonˆBasicˆCushionˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆdebitˆcardˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆCushionˆisˆpartˆofˆtheˆpaidˆplans.ˆIt'sˆhowˆweˆgiveˆmembersˆaˆlittleˆroomˆwithoutˆchargingˆoverdraftˆfees.ˆ##ˆGettingˆCushionˆMoveˆtoˆPlusˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00,ˆorˆtoˆPremiumˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆOverdraftˆfeesˆBasicˆhasˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00).ˆTransactionsˆthatˆwouldˆoverdrawˆyourˆaccountˆareˆdeclinedˆinstead.ˆ##ˆCanˆaˆBasicˆbalanceˆgoˆnegative?ˆOccasionally,ˆforˆexampleˆifˆaˆmerchantˆpostsˆmoreˆthanˆitˆauthorizedˆorˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆdepositˆrepaysˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆautomatically.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆdeclinedˆtransaction.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
PremiumˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPremiumˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆATMˆfeesˆfromˆus,ˆandˆweˆpayˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆmonth.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
